title: Group chat patch notes
prompt: Write three changes a fictional update would make to your hangout. Photograph the object that inspired the funniest fix.

title: The dinner we could improvise
prompt: Pick three ingredients people already have. Sketch a meal you could make together and write who would tackle each part.

title: Skills worth stealing
prompt: Demonstrate a trick you learned through practice. Let a friend draw its crucial step and photograph their illustrated instructions.

title: Two witnesses, one afternoon
prompt: Recall an outing two friends attended. Draw the scene separately and photograph the details that both drawings share.

title: Silent trailer
prompt: Stage three stills for a film about the last ten minutes. Save the middle frame and let a friend write the tagline.

title: Calendar archaeology
prompt: Think of a day everyone somehow made time to meet. Draw its unofficial invitation and save the detail that made it happen.

title: Before the shortcut
prompt: Compare two ways you learned to do the same job. Sketch the old and new tools and caption the trade-off you remember.

title: An accent worth keeping
prompt: Trade local sayings you love. Illustrate one literally and add the meaning a visitor would need.

title: Low-budget boss fight
prompt: Turn a cushion or mug into the final boss of a game. Photograph its arena and invent its one ridiculous weakness.

title: Ten-minute skill share
prompt: Teach a friend one small skill, such as a paper fold or a drawing shortcut. Photograph their first attempt and their advice for the next learner.

title: Three eras of a street
prompt: Choose a street two people remember. Draw its remembered past, its present and a possible future on one strip.

title: The public bench dedication
prompt: Choose a real or imaginary bench and dedicate it to a friendship moment. Photograph a paper plaque and explain the choice.

title: The lost reaction image
prompt: Make a reaction image using only objects. Let someone guess the message it answers before you caption it.

title: The corner shop window
prompt: Arrange ordinary items as a shop display for a shop your group would run. Photograph the window and invent opening-day specials.

title: Second-act prospectus
prompt: Invent a one-day apprenticeship each friend would enjoy trying. Photograph the course list with a first lesson for each.

title: Mystery tune in pictures
prompt: Draw clues to a tune without using letters. Have friends guess, then record what the melody brings back for each person.

title: Pocket festival
prompt: Give each friend a stage name and an everyday object as an instrument. Draw the lineup on paper and photograph the poster.

title: Friendship commute map
prompt: Draw the routes that first brought you together. Mark the place where two paths crossed and caption the coincidence.

title: Record sleeve reunion
prompt: Pick a song linked to an earlier chapter of life. Design new sleeve art inspired by where you are together now.

title: A recipe in someone's hands
prompt: Recall a cook's gesture that a recipe never captured. Demonstrate it with an empty bowl and caption the missing instruction.

title: Three-frame speedrun
prompt: Invent a tiny challenge you can finish from a chair. Photograph its finish line and record the most creative solution.

title: Spare-room supper club
prompt: Design a place setting from things within reach. Photograph it and decide which shared story would open dinner.

title: The object that stayed
prompt: Describe something that followed you through several moves. Draw or photograph its stand-in and mark its most surprising stop.

title: The long-running joke
prompt: Tell the origin stories of a phrase the group still uses. Photograph a prop with two versions of how it began.

title: Side character diaries
prompt: Choose a background object. Take its portrait and co-write the diary entry it would make about your group.

title: Break-time expedition
prompt: Spend a short break inspecting a familiar corner. Each find one detail everyone else missed and photograph a group favorite.

title: Friendly pub quiz
prompt: Write three questions whose answers come from the group's own stories. Photograph the answer sheet after everyone guesses.

title: Teach me your opening
prompt: Invent or demonstrate the first move of a tabletop game. Let a friend counter it and save a diagram of the position.

title: Bad pitch night
prompt: Pitch an absurd use for an ordinary object in twenty seconds each. Photograph the prototype and quote the best pitch.

title: Tiny repair clinic
prompt: Pick an object with an annoying flaw. Draw two possible fixes together and photograph the one you would actually try.

title: What I changed my mind about
prompt: Choose an everyday taste or hobby you warmed to over time. Make a before-and-after sketch and compare turning points.

title: Neighborhood oral history
prompt: Choose a nearby landmark or one you remember. Invite each person to contribute one sentence and photograph the illustrated account.

title: Outfit from another planet
prompt: Arrange scraps or leaves as a tiny outfit for a visitor from space. Photograph it and explain the local dress code.

title: House rules exchange
prompt: Each share one unwritten rule from a household you know. Write an illustrated rulebook page for a fictional shared house.

title: An argument for keeping it
prompt: Find an object someone might discard. Take turns arguing for a second use, then stage and photograph the winning design.

title: An invitation from the past
prompt: Recreate an invitation to a gathering you remember fondly. Add one guest's recollection of what actually happened.

title: Fake season finale
prompt: Pose objects for the cliffhanger ending of today's hangout. Caption the photo with the question viewers would argue about.

title: The recurring appointment
prompt: Design a repeatable five-minute ritual for the next time you meet. Photograph its cue and write how to start it.

title: First paycheck museum
prompt: Recall something you bought, saved for or borrowed early on. Draw a museum label for it and compare why it mattered.

title: The pocket puzzle exchange
prompt: Arrange five objects in a pattern with one hidden rule. Let a friend solve it and photograph their explanation.

title: Reverse scavenger hunt
prompt: Start with a photo of something nearby. Give increasingly strange clues until a friend finds the subject.

title: Kitchen relay on paper
prompt: Start a recipe with one step. Each friend adds the next from imagination. Photograph the result and name the dish.

title: The reluctant expert
prompt: Ask a friend what people often seek their help with. Stage a photo for the cover of their imaginary handbook.

title: A duet of descriptions
prompt: Describe the same familiar view using only sound, then only color. Save a photo or drawing with both descriptions.

title: Soundtrack draft
prompt: Take turns drafting song titles for the opening, plot twist and credits of today. Photograph the handwritten track list.

title: After-hours field notes
prompt: Choose a familiar place and imagine its evening shift. Sketch a page of observations and add one detail from real life.

title: Two versions of the recipe
prompt: Compare two ways of preparing a familiar dish. Sketch the point where the methods diverge and record both explanations.

title: Museum of first names
prompt: Recall the first name or nickname of a memorable place. Design a sign for it and tell a friend why the name stuck.

title: Emoji translation desk
prompt: Describe a shared incident with three drawn symbols. Photograph the puzzle and add the group's best translation.

title: The hobby we nearly started
prompt: Pick an activity two friends have always meant to try. Make a paper invitation and sketch the very first practice exercise.

title: Hometown radio hour
prompt: Make a running order for a five-minute radio show about a place you know. Include one local sound and one personal story.

title: One tool, many teachers
prompt: Choose a skill passed between people. Draw the chain of teachers and photograph the step you would pass on next.

title: Forced perspective lab
prompt: Use distance to make a tiny object look enormous beside another. Save the illusion and its behind-the-scenes secret.

title: A table for old neighbors
prompt: Design a seating plan for memorable people from past neighborhoods. Share one reason two of the guests should meet.

title: Challenge the house champion
prompt: Design a tabletop accuracy game with folded paper. Play a round, then photograph the rule change that made it more interesting.

title: The encore nobody planned
prompt: Tell a story about something unexpected that improved a gathering. Stage the turning point with objects and title the scene.

title: Micro-zine exchange
prompt: Fold one sheet into four panels. Each person adds a line or doodle about today, then photograph the cover.

title: Lost weekend souvenir
prompt: Make a souvenir for a trip you never took together. Photograph it with the imaginary mishap that made the trip memorable.

title: The road you almost took
prompt: Choose a harmless fork in the road from years ago. Sketch two alternate postcards and share the story behind one.

title: A map drawn from voices
prompt: Draw a remembered route while another friend supplies landmarks aloud. Save the map with one place you pictured differently.

title: Invent a fandom
prompt: Choose an overlooked object to become obsessed with for five minutes. Design its fan badge and photograph the first edition.

title: The good shortcut
prompt: Each teach a tiny shortcut that makes ordinary days easier. Photograph a demonstration and credit the person who taught it.

title: Borrowed wisdom audit
prompt: Each recall advice you once received. Rewrite one piece for a friend facing the same situation today and photograph both versions.

title: A new rule for an old game
prompt: Pick a familiar word or paper game. Each propose a new rule, try one round and photograph the winning rulebook.

title: Wrong answers tour
prompt: Point out three ordinary features nearby and invent extravagant fictional explanations. Save a photo with the favorite tall tale.

title: Borrow my eyes
prompt: Take turns framing the same workaday object as if it belonged to another profession. Save the most unexpected interpretation.

title: Neighborhood texture atlas
prompt: Look for two textures that suggest different chapters of a place. Photograph one and sketch a map key for both.

title: The neighborhood editor
prompt: Imagine editing a one-page paper about today. Assign a headline, sketch a picture and save the story someone else would have missed.

title: One-take storyboard
prompt: Draw a scene one panel at a time without planning its ending. Photograph the twist and title the episode.

title: Five-minute reunion
prompt: Recreate the first few minutes of a memorable reunion using objects as stand-ins. Photograph the scene before the first greeting.

title: Unlikely doubles team
prompt: Pair two unrelated skills from the group into an imaginary team event. Draw its emblem and demonstrate its opening move.

title: Small pleasures tasting notes
prompt: Compare a familiar drink, sound or texture in the style of expert reviewers. Photograph the subject and the group's most precise description.

title: Mystery inventory
prompt: Empty three harmless objects onto a table. Design a fictional character who owns them all and photograph the clues.

title: The unfinished project fair
prompt: Sketch a project each friend once abandoned. Pair two sketches into a new invention and photograph the mash-up.

title: Your first day again
prompt: Trade stories of starting something unfamiliar. Arrange objects as a first-day survival kit and caption its strangest item.

title: Postcards across decades
prompt: Pick one place and write two postcard greetings set decades apart. Photograph them and describe what both visitors would recognize.

title: Lobby screen
prompt: Draw the loading screen for your group's next adventure. Everyone adds a useful or wildly unhelpful tip.

title: Our neighborhood ballot
prompt: Nominate nearby details for playful awards, like best-shaped shadow. Make a paper ballot and save the winning detail.

title: The changing skyline
prompt: Outline a view you remember, then outline the view in front of you. Photograph the two shapes and name what anchors each.

title: A portrait in possessions
prompt: Build a portrait of a friend from three objects they choose. Photograph it and let them write the caption.

title: Parallel universe lunch
prompt: Design an imaginary menu where every dish is named after an inside joke. Photograph the special of the day.

title: Dinner-party question deck
prompt: Everyone writes one question they would genuinely like to be asked. Photograph the deck and answer one together.

title: The lost instruction sheet
prompt: Pick a familiar tool and draw instructions for someone seeing it for the first time. Let a friend test the drawings.

title: The celebration we invented
prompt: Design a holiday for an overlooked pleasure your friends share. Draw its emblem and agree on a first annual custom.

title: Cover art swap
prompt: Everyone sketches a cover for the same invented song. Put the covers side by side and caption their different moods.

title: Parallel Tuesdays
prompt: Compare what each person usually does at the same time on a Tuesday. Draw a split-screen scene and caption the contrast.

title: One good conversation
prompt: Recall a conversation that nudged you toward something new. Photograph a symbolic object and save the question that helped.

title: A question for the next visit
prompt: Ask each friend for a story they have always wanted to hear. Photograph one question and spend a few minutes on its answer.

title: Glitch portrait
prompt: Arrange strips of colored paper into a deliberately glitched face. Photograph it and name its current emotion.

title: The thank-you prototype
prompt: Think of a favor a friend once did. Design a tiny monument to the favor using nearby objects and photograph the dedication.

title: An exhibition in three labels
prompt: Curate three objects around an interest you share. Write labels from different viewpoints and photograph the entrance piece.

title: Committee for beautiful mistakes
prompt: Recall a harmless mistake that turned into a good story. Make a ribbon for it and photograph the citation.

title: Friendship achievement
prompt: Design a game achievement for something a friend did today. Photograph the badge with its unlock condition.

title: A spare hour itinerary
prompt: Build an outing that fits into a spare hour with zero spending. Photograph your hand-drawn map and its optional detour.

title: Small rebellions anthology
prompt: Share a time you quietly did something your own way. Illustrate one story as a single comic panel with a friend's caption.

title: The apprentice takes over
prompt: Invite someone to teach a new paper fold, rhythm or sketch. Switch teacher and learner, then save the two attempts together.

title: One-star review club
prompt: Write an affectionate one-star review of an imaginary inconvenience, like gravity for a dropped pencil. Photograph the evidence.

title: Postcard from next year
prompt: Each write one ordinary thing you hope the group is still doing next year. Photograph the cards as a set.

title: The next first
prompt: Choose a small first you would like to experience together. Invent a ticket for it and photograph the stub.

title: Tomorrow's correspondence
prompt: Write a short invitation to something new your group could try. Illustrate it together and photograph the detail everyone wants to remember.
